_comment: Machine-readable gate for docs/WINDOWS-UPSTREAM-SYNC.md#known-upstream-regressions. The Markdown entry keeps the evidence; tools/windows/sync-inventory.ps1 and diff-guard.ps1 read this file. status 'reverted' is enforced; 'resolved' is history only. Files changed by revertSha are the watched paths. absentIdentifiers must not appear in src/ or tests/ of a candidate while the regression is reverted.

regressions.title: perf(qwen27b): capture DFlash2 prompt features into bounded pinned host memory
regressions.symptom: Pinned capture is deferred: nine matched long-context timing cells fail across two candidate and three baseline observations. Warm sampled replay takes 405-420 ms versus 352-359 ms. The independent upload-failure drain fix remains included.
reintroductionChecks: Review the Windows fix and cite the sync log; preserve the retained DFlash upload-failure drain and its native test.
Match production binary/runtime identities, model, settings, actual RAM/staging/disk capacities, and all preceding cache history.
Run affected Qwen AR/DFlash2 numerical, cancelled-prefill, image/seeded continuation, long-context/cache and batch checks, plus Flash-Next AR/MTP controls for shared cache changes.

Compare each affected request/phase at unchanged 5% and 3 ms limits with alternating candidate/base and fresh unchanged-base controls. Retain every failure and inconclusive observation; do not aggregate unmatched cancellation frontiers.

Run varied 10-16K-token fresh-process Qwen AR/DFlash2 first prompts with reuse enabled and disabled, and the standard pp2048/tg128 benchmark. Verify actual drafts, exact output and expected cache work.

regressions.title: perf(qwen): reduce Flash-Next sampled decoding overhead
regressions.symptom: Windows/TheRock first-request MTP decode regresses (60.90/63.35 ms against 51.32-57.51 ms baseline controls).
reintroductionChecks: Review the upstream fix and cite the sync log entry.
Fresh-process varied 10-16K-token Windows AR/MTP first-prompt controls, then repeat with prompt reuse disabled, against the previous Windows binary.
Retain every phase, output and cache/draft count; apply the 5% and 3 ms request-phase gates.
